symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1588: `create java action` had no way to set a parameter's description or the return value's name; `describe` printed both as `--` comments (`Input: String not null  -- The text to convert.`, `-- return NAME: 'UpperText'`), and a script copying that form passed check and exec with the description empty and the return name `ReturnValueName`
cause: no grammar slot for either: javaActionParameter had no docComment and javaActionReturnType no `AS VARIABLE`, so the only spelling describe could offer was a comment the lexer discards. The writers carried the stored values (#705, #731), which hid the gap on round trips of Studio Pro-authored actions and made it total on new ones
file: mdl/grammar/domains/MDLMicroflow.g4 (javaActionParameter: docComment?, javaActionReturnType: AS VARIABLE); mdl/visitor/visitor_javaaction.go (buildJavaActionParams, buildJavaActionReturn — one helper for the Java and JavaScript handlers); mdl/executor/cmd_javaactions.go + cmd_javascript_actions_write.go (carriedDocumentation per parameter, stated ReturnName wins); cmd_javaactions.go writeCodeActionParams / describeCodeActionReturnName shared by both describers
test: cmd_javaactions_param_description_test.go: create, rewrite (stated replaces, unstated carries) and describe round trip, for Java and JavaScript actions
insight: When describe prints a value as a comment, ask whether create has a slot for it — a comment in describe output is either decoration or an unspellable property, and only the second is a bug. Pick the spelling the language already uses for the same thing elsewhere (a member's `/** */` as on an attribute, `returns T as $Name` as on a microflow): the reporter had tried exactly those two first. Java and JavaScript actions share the grammar rules, so a field read by only one handler would have been a fresh silent drop in the other — both visitors now go through one helper and both describers through one emitter. The `--` form had also kept only the first line of a multi-line description; the doc comment carries all of it, and carriedDocumentation's normal form keeps a CRLF description from churning on describe → exec
